title: EastWest Dream Run 2026 Manila Review: Runrio's Alabang Series Opener
seo_title: EastWest Dream Run Manila 2026 Review | Philippines Race
meta_description: EastWest Dream Run 2026 Manila: August 2 at Filinvest Alabang. Runrio-produced with registration open — a bank-branded Philippine road race.
dek: Set for 2 August 2026 at Filinvest Alabang in Muntinlupa, this Runrio-produced EastWest Bank race offers four distances with registration open. The Manila leg of a nationwide series.
verdict: The EastWest Dream Run Manila is a Runrio-produced, EastWest Bank-branded road race at Filinvest Alabang — one of Metro Manila's premier running venues with wide, well-maintained roads. Four distances with registration open. Runrio's gold-standard production and EastWest's bank branding make this a professionally-produced, accessible race experience. Part of a nationwide series with legs in Clark and Iloilo. For Manila runners wanting a bank-backed, Runrio-produced race with open registration, this is a solid pick.

sections.heading: Runrio + EastWest at Filinvest
paragraphs: Runrio's production (chip timing, aid stations, professional race-day ops) pairs with EastWest Bank's commercial backing. [1] Filinvest Alabang's wide roads in Muntinlupa provide a flat, fast course. Registration is open.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: A Runrio-produced, bank-backed Manila race with open registration. 2 August 2026 at Filinvest Alabang. [1]

faqs.question: When is EastWest Dream Run Manila 2026?
faqs.answer: 2 August 2026 at Filinvest Alabang, Muntinlupa. Registration open. It offers 21K, 10K, 5K, 3K, and 1K. Runrio (brand: EastWest Dream Run) organises the event. Mark it on your calendar if you're planning your racing year around it. [1]
